basis: Retinal dystrophy, obesity/hypogonadism and neurodevelopmental impairment define BBS; CKD 30-79%; skeletal and dental abnormalities omitted because of cap.
Carcinoma originates in the uterine cervix, a reproductive organ outside the axes; HPV association alone does not make the carcinoma an infection.
Cerebral vessel fragility with hemorrhagic brain injury, leukoencephalopathy and porencephaly defines this cerebrovascular disorder.
Schwann-cell neoplasm of the nervous system; melanin production does not establish skin involvement.
Peroxisomal metabolic disorder defined by progressive cerebellar ataxia and motor axonal neuropathy; abnormal pursuit reflects neurologic dysfunction.
Neurodegenerative osteopetrosis; marrow failure with anemia/thrombocytopenia ~67-75% and optic atrophy ~50-67%; hepatomegaly alone does not establish liver damage.
Peripheral sensorimotor neuropathy; denervation amyotrophy reported in 2/2 and permanent foot deformity in most, with pes cavus eventually universal.
Corneal degeneration is confined to the ocular axis.
Fibronectin deposition damages glomeruli, causing proteinuria and renal insufficiency; secondary hypertension is separately diagnosed, not direct vascular deposition.
Biopsy-supported rimmed-vacuole muscular dystrophy; supplied phenotypes do not establish peripheral nerve damage. Dysphagia alone does not establish GI damage.
Preeclampsia is defined by gestational hypertension with renal proteinuria or other organ dysfunction; eclamptic brain injury, hepatic injury and cytopenias affect minorities.
Mitochondrial energy-metabolism defect; hypertrophic cardiomyopathy 7/7, developmental delay 4/4 and brain atrophy 2/2; apnea alone does not establish lung damage.
Joubert brain malformation and developmental impairment; retinopathy in 1/2 supports ocular damage. Renal pelvic dilation in 1/2 lacks demonstrated functional injury.
Malignant neoplasm involving the uterine cervix, a reproductive organ outside the axes; no common direct damage to an included organ is established.
Isolated sperm motility defect causing male infertility; reproductive function is outside the axes, with no endocrine dysfunction established.
Fetal iodine imbalance causes thyroid dysfunction and irreversible neurodevelopmental injury; sensorineural hearing impairment is very frequent, 80-99%.
Cerebrovascular disease causes ischemic brain injury and persistent cognitive decline; both cerebral vessels and brain define the condition.
Congenital craniosynostosis directly affects skull bones; maternal hyperthyroiditis does not by itself establish endocrine disease in the affected child.
Dilated cardiomyopathy, woolly hair/keratoderma and tooth agenesis are defining manifestations; teeth belong to the gastrointestinal axis.
Hypomyelinating leukodystrophy with spastic ataxia; fixed joint contractures 4/5 and scoliosis 2/3 support musculoskeletal damage. Oculomotor signs are neurologic.
Joubert CNS malformations; biliary atresia 6/8, renal cystic abnormalities 6/8 and skeletal malformations including polydactyly 7/8 and trident pelvis 3/5.
Immune-mediated granulomatous skin inflammation with inflammatory arthritis defines the syndrome; skin and joints are primary sites.
Dystonia and progressive cerebellar degeneration define the disease; nystagmus, dysphagia and dysphonia do not independently establish eye, GI or airway damage.
Phosphocalcic disorder with subcutaneous calcified masses; muscle calcification 80-99% and hyperostosis 30-79% support musculoskeletal involvement; renal calcification 5-29% excluded.
Familial median nerve entrapment neuropathy; tenosynovitis has unspecified frequency. TTR association alone does not establish systemic amyloid organ damage.
